text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are you lonely? Would you like some<n>company? Do
you want to lay down<n>on my lap?
choice_data_list: Wh-what's this all of a sudden?
Wh-what's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's just that nobody's been coming<n>to me to be
coddled lately...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I really wanna ruffle someone's<n>hair, or give
out big hugs, or shower<n>people with compliments...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I feel so unwanted. Won't youlet me spoil you?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Super Creek isn't<n>feeling her best
because she hasn't<n>been able to coddle anyone for
a<n>while like she usually does.
